review_notes: I read the whole file and the sibling VariableBody files that use these lemmas (HalfspaceCoefficients, CellAreaContinuity, Partition) and PrimeRefinement/Iteration. I also checked the BodySpace.PositiveArea simp lemmas for toGeometryConvexBody. solidBody_carrier and solidBody_area are needed: solidBody is an ordinary def, so the toGeometryConvexBody simp lemmas don't fire on it syntactically. They are also harmless. The main concern is the two @[simp] definitional-unfolding lemmas, cellSet_def and cellArea_def. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about observed simp behaviour or failures. Every use I found names these lemmas explicitly (simp only [...] or rw), so I can't show a concrete downstream breakage. The finding rests on the design: the lemmas undo the file's abstraction, and nothing in the repo needs them as default simp rules.

findings.problem: Both `cellSet_def` and `cellArea_def` are `rfl` unfolding lemmas tagged `@[simp]`. Any default `simp` call on a goal containing `cellSet hA C s w i` or `cellArea hA C s w i` therefore rewrites them to `PowerDiagram.bodyCellSet (solidBody hA C) s.pts w i` and the matching `bodyCellArea` form. The rewrite is unwanted: the file introduces `cellSet`/`cellArea` as the variable-body vocabulary, and the API lemmas (`cellSet_convex`, `cellSet_isCompact`, `cellSet_subset_parent`, `cellSet_subset_body`) are stated about `cellSet`, so they stop matching once it is unfolded. The result is also a half-normal form: `solidBody` has no unfolding simp lemma. `solidBody_carrier` and `solidBody_area` apply only to the coercion and to `.area`, so the unfolded term `bodyCellSet (solidBody hA C) ...` still mentions `solidBody`. The `@[simp]` is also unused: downstream proofs name the lemmas explicitly (`simp only [cellSet_def, ...]` in HalfspaceCoefficients, `rw [cellArea_def, cellSet_def]` in CellAreaContinuity, `simp only [cellSet_def]` at line 115 here).
findings.proposed_change: Drop `@[simp]` from `cellSet_def` and `cellArea_def`; they still work in the explicit `simp only [...]` and `rw [...]` calls that use them. Alternatively delete them and use the auto-generated equation lemmas (`cellSet.eq_1`, `unfold cellSet`). Keep `cellSet`/`cellArea` as the simp-normal form. If a simp interface is wanted, add targeted lemmas about `cellSet`/`cellArea` instead, such as `cellSet` membership or area facts.
findings.benefit: Default `simp` no longer exposes `bodyCellSet (solidBody …)` in goals about variable-body cells. The `cellSet_*` API keeps matching, and the unfolding happens only where a proof asks for it. Existing explicit uses are unaffected.
